01.title: The engagement
content: Replace the spreadsheet quoting process with Sales Cloud quoting; success spine: quote turnaround from 9 days to 2.

02.title: What came before
content: A June assessment settled the CRM platform decision; pricing model design was left deliberately open.

03.title: Process and current state
content: Quotes are built in a 14-tab spreadsheet owned by one analyst; the approval step is a manual email chain.

04.title: System landscape
content: ERP (keep, owner: client IT director), legacy CRM (replace), tax engine (connect).

gaps.question: Sandbox access for the tax engine

05.title: Solution shape
content: Sales Cloud owns quoting; ERP keeps order fulfillment; one nightly sync crosses the seam. Depth lives in the Solution Brief.

06.title: Decisions inherited
content: Two-phase rollout chosen over big bang (settled, Pursuit Lead, 2026-07-08). Maturity-gap flag carried: ERP integration.

07.title: Sell-cycle promises
content: AE told the sponsor a report pack would be included; not in the SOW. Flagged, owner: Pursuit Lead, route: price as change order or reset.

08.title: Risks, assumptions, gaps
content: Assumption: under 50,000 records migrate from a clean source; if false, the migration estimate reopens.

09.title: The people
content: Economic buyer (CFO) was in the deal cycle but is not on the delivery roster: flagged mismatch, routed to session 2.

10.title: Relevant prior engagements
content: The 2025 distributor build's approval-matrix template applies; lives in the prior-engagement Drive folder.

sessions.name: Confirm the migration source record count against the SOW assumption
sessions.output: A confirmed record count and a signed-off extract sample

criteria.criterion: A configured-bundle quote reaches approved state without a spreadsheet touch
criteria.binary_test: Watch a rep run one live quote end to end in production

readiness.item: Executed SOW and quote reconciled against section 01

promises.text: A management report pack will be included at no charge
